gloss: The question Z&C cannot yet answer
lede: The strongest criticism of zebra companies is stated by one of Z&C's own founding shareholders. She says she still cannot fully rebut it.

blocks.text: Zebra companies don't aim to go public; aren't they just avoiding growth that they could achieve?
blocks.who: The question SIIF's stakeholders asked in 2021

blocks.text: Regarding the question posed three years ago of whether zebra companies are just avoiding growth, I still feel I cannot provide a flawless logical rebuttal.
blocks.role: Executive Director, Japan Social Innovation and Investment Foundation (SIIF); shareholder in Zebras and Company

blocks.text: Yet, looking back at the efforts of the companies supported by Zebras and Company, it is clear that this is far from mere avoidance. These companies tackle extraordinary challenges: sustaining business growth while, for example, preserving the prosperity of towns with populations under a few hundred, updating agricultural practices in aging regions, or driving changes in people's mindsets and behaviors. These are not easy tasks.
On the other hand, zebra-style investors are still few, and I strongly hope that more examples of funding with a "Different Scale" approach will emerge.
